name: Sanderson Farms
old_description: Our portfolio of brands help nourish people around the world.
about:
Wayne-Sanderson Farms is headquartered in Collins, Mississippi. The company was formed from two leading poultry companies with humble roots, bringing together over a century of industry expertise.

The company produces high-quality, affordable poultry brands and products, operating as the nation's third-largest poultry producer. Its network includes more than 26,000 team members and over 2,000 family farmers. Operations emphasize efficient production, resource conservation, renewable energy, and waste reduction.

Wayne-Sanderson Farms serves customers and consumers worldwide, supplying retail, foodservice, and institutional markets. Notable partnerships include being named the official chicken of the Southeastern Conference and collaborations with professional athletes such as LPGA golfer Jenny Bae, whose family has raised chickens for the company for a decade.

The company states its vision is to be "amazing by being the partner of choice," differentiating itself through sustainable impact commitments and community investment, such as the Sanderson Farms Championship which generated $1.75 million for Mississippi charities in 2024, and a rescue truck donation that upgraded local emergency response capabilities.
